title: A status change records who made it and when
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user (Admin) · 1 browser · about 10 minutes
  • Build: the Part Lifecycle QA build (no build exists yet; use the build named in the test run).
  • User: [Admin] = you, signed in with the Admin role, which by default has 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete' and See Financial Data.
  • Location: [Loc-1] = the location picked in the top-bar location switcher at the start; every step runs at [Loc-1] unless it names another location.
  • Data: [Part-A] = tracked part, active.
  • Names and numbers marked (e.g. …) are examples only. What must hold is the status (active or inactive), tracking, quantity and link described above.

Setup

  1. Go to Parts → Inventory, click "New Inventory Part" and fill in Description (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL WHOWHEN PART), Part Number (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-WHOWHEN-01), Category (e.g. Uncategorized), Cost (e.g. $10.00), Sell Price (e.g. $20.00); leave "Track quantities and cost of goods" on; set the default bin's Quantity to 4; click Save.
  2. [Part-A] = the part number you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-WHOWHEN-01); [Desc-A] = the description you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL WHOWHEN PART).
  3. [Staff-1] = [Admin]'s name as Part History shows it (e.g. the name on your profile).
  4. Check the setup worked: [Part-A] is on the Active tab and has no Deactivated entry in Part History (clock icon).
custom_steps:
1. Write down the date and time on your computer clock. [T-1] = that time.
  2. On the Active tab search [Part-A], click its row, pick Part Status "Inactive", click Save, leave the note empty and click "Deactivate" in the "Deactivate part?" confirmation.
  3. On the Inactive tab click the clock icon ("Part History") on [Part-A]'s row.
  4. Read the newest entry.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 4: The newest entry reads "Deactivated", Staff [Staff-1], Date today, Time [T-1] or a minute or two later.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10823 (Story 10, Confirming and Recording a Status Change); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v26 (Ready for dev), S10-R14, read 8 Oct 2026; design canvas board 3.8 (Finding it in Part History). Source-verified 8 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).
